description: process_create inserts DeliveryStatus::new("250 OK", Delivered::Yes, Displayed::Unknown) into the submission object before any actual SMTP send occurs. EmailSubmission/get will therefore return delivered: "yes" for submissions that may be queued or failed. A contributor adding async delivery will not notice this must be initialized to Delivered::Queued; the incorrect initial state is invisible.
title: process_create sets delivery_status to Delivered::Yes before actual delivery
